title: teucrium glaucum
intro: Teucrium glaucum, commonly known as Kresten, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) that has been used for its medicinal properties for centuries. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium glaucum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. These bioactive compounds have been shown to scavenge free radicals, inhibit enzyme activity, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making Teucrium glaucum a valuable plant for the production of traditional and modern medicines.
